steps.name: Fang
steps.text: How did I let Kroos slip away again...?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Don't be mad, Captain. Kroos isn't a bad girl.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It's just—I'm supervising her work, and every single time...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: She just wants to take it easy sometimes.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Next time, maybe you should be the one keeping an eye on her. It kind of feels like she listens to you more...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It's not like I do anything special either. I just watch her work.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: If she needs my help, l help her, and she goes back to doing it herself after a while.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Well, what can I say? I shouldn't have expected any less from you, Beagle.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I'm not sure why, but whenever she has half a mind to slack off, there is just no way I can keep her working...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Sometimes she's got a stomachache. Sometimes it's Instructor Dobermann calling for her, and I always just believe her.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: And before I know it, she's gone.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Kroos, back to duty with me!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (I'm just trying to take a short break!)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Huh? Why is Fang getting faster and faster?!)

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Is there anything else you would like to listen to?'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Okay, Lens will look it up in the library.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is it okay if I sit down next to you, Scene?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Miss Scene says she doesn't mind. Go ahead!'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I mean, there's a Kuranta chasing me~

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Oh, I can hear her now. It's Fang.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We're actually playing hide-and-seek right now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And after she found me, it kind of turned into a race~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey, Lens. Help me out, will you?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Miss Scene says it sounds very interesting. Lens will therefore be providing all the assistance you need, Kroos.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'However, I can't guarantee that Fang won't recognize you.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, if she catches me, I guess she'll have rightfully earned her victory~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Oh, have these buggies been here the whole time? I didn't even notice.)

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I know she hopped in here for sure.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: She's getting way too good at hiding...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Fang—I saw Kroos run toward the cafeteria!

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Congratulations, Kroos. It looks like you're still hidden.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I've seen the way Scene hides on missions before.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Lens uses a revolutionary new camouflage technique that combines stealth and optical refraction technologies, among others, to satisfy Miss Scene's needs.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'I'm sorry, Miss Scene. Lens forgot to put on music for you.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is it okay if I chill here for a little bit, too?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: By the way, what are you doing here, Scene?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Miss Scene is brainstorming ideas for her next piece.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'She may look like she's spacing out, but make no mistake. She's thinking.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'And while she has her thinking cap on, it is Lens's job to play music and deliver food to her.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Isn't there anyone chasing her down, trying to get her to work?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'If anyone tried to, Lens would activate these camouflage techniques. No one would be able to find her.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I wish I could live like Scene does.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'I believe Miss Scene said something similar before.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Something along the lines of, 'I wish I could live the way Cautuses do—' Something like that.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What's so nice about us Cautuses?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ever since I was young, everyone's always told me that Cautuses are meant to be more energetic, and that I shouldn't be so lazy.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But all I ever wanna do is clear my mind and lay on the couch the whole day.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'What Miss Scene is saying is you can make your own decisions, and that is a joy in itself.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Lens is able to take photos very quickly. Through the use of my system's auxiliary operations, Lens is capable of snapping photos of running Kuranta and storing those photos in my album without issues.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Even when she's photographing people, Miss Scene takes a very long time, almost like she's sketching.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'That's why Miss Scene is a good scenery photographer. She's not good at it because she likes taking photos of landscapes.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'She wants to take photos of everything, but, most of the time, she's only able to take photos of still objects. Only they have the patience to wait until she's done without moving.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'You don't like to move, but if you put your mind to it, you can still be pretty agile.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Both Lens and Click have edited operational records of your missions, Kroos.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'You usually just hang out around the destination, but once an order comes, you always head towards the new destination quickly. That makes you no different from the other Cautuses.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's just because I could die if I mess up~

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Without Lens, Miss Scene wouldn't even be able to move to the next location.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Lens believes there's a difference between can't do and don't want to do.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'There are too many things that we can't do, so let's do the things that we can do the best we can.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'This is something that Scene told Lens before.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Of course, Miss Scene may be able to do fewer things, but the things that she can do, she does with relative ease.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'In your case, Lens supposes you probably focus on putting your energy where it matters because you know your limits?'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But it could also be because I don't wanna work.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Oh, sorry about that. The reception here isn't very good.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'The motivational r-routine that Lens s-selected to inspire you had a few e-errors.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Scene, are you trying to say something?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Gotcha. I'll look for Mayer. You stay here to look after Lens.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'm sorry, Fang, I got mixed up and went after the wrong person.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: You know, there's quite a bit of difference between Leonhardt and Kroos...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'm so sorry! I should've been more careful!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It's fine. Let's look for her again. If we don't find her, we'll have to ask Meteor or Gitano for help.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Kroos isn't going to get away.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: It kind of seems like she's got your full attention today, Captain.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: You usually turn a blind eye, but you seem really mad this time.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: You know what Kroos said when she ran away?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: She said today's the anniversary of me becoming our leader, so she was going to pick out a present for me.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: She never came back, in the end. I didn't even realize until you returned to the dorm.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Then that's really mean of her.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I'll give her a good scolding myself.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I hope I'm not seeing things again...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Looks like she's in a hurry.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Come. Let's go take a look.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Isn't this an automatic door? Why isn't it opening?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I need a favor. Is it okay~?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Ehh, my ventilation fan is on. Why is it so strong over here?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I'm painting right now. Why don't you step outside first?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Let me finish up here. I'll be right with you!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If you just want some quick repairs, you should try Engineering. I don't think I'll be much help.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh—Lens is dead? Shouldn't you get Closure then?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You're in luck today. I don't have anything in that much of a rush. Otherwise, you'd have come all this way for nothing.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Keep in mind, though, if those A.I. things with the four wheels run into problems, you should try Closure first.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Looks like Kroos is actually busy!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Huh? We don't need to follow her anymore?

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: If she's actually busy, then let's not get in the way.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: We'll clean up Kroos's mess for her and get something to eat.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hey, slow down. I haven't had breakfast...

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Lens actually rebooted not long after you left.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Lens sometimes runs into problems with certain functions. It isn't uncommon for Lens to reboot.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Oh, you mean what Miss Scene was trying to say? She was trying to tell you that it's okay.'

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'She takes a liiiittle while to get her words out, so she might've given you the wrong impression.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Well, guess I came all the way here for nothing.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Sorry about that, Miss Mayer. Lens is doing very well.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Well, let me take a look...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Doesn't seem like there's anything wrong on the outside.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You said you crashed just now, right?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Then that should be a problem with the system.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You said it yourself. You reboot often, right?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Closure didn't try to fix that for you?

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Closure has already ordered replacement parts for Lens. It won't be long before Lens receives an upgrade.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: So those parts were for you, huh?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I visited that dungeon of hers yesterday. She was working for the better part of the day.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: She said it was some kind of 'advanced component used in extreme circumstances to be installed on a high-end mobile photography platform.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Well, this is perfect. Let's go pay Closure a visit now. We'll take care of this problem of yours.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: That way, you won't find yourself freezing up or having to install OS updates while you're out on a mission.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'But Lens is afraid it takes Miss Scene a while to get around too. Lens will walk with Miss Scene, so we likely won't be able to come with you straight to Closure's.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Okay, let's get going, then. Get it over with quickly, and I'll get to go to bed early. I have lots of work to get done tomorrow.

steps.name: Lens
steps.text: 'Oh, Mayer, please don't push me around like that!'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Don't worry, Miss Mayer's just a little impatient~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Let's just take our time and walk there slowly~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Fang, here's some dessert I picked up for you~

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Leave them on the table. We'll share them tomorrow.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: We're going to bed. It's all yours.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: See, Fang? Kroos actually worked all day.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: She even bought you a present.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I wasn't trying to reprimand her, you know.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: If she really wants to take a break, all she has to do is tell me. I'm not going to say no.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: It's just the way she goes about makes me kinda upset sometimes.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos is too shy to actually say it. She's actually really thoughtful.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: I kind of think she's just toying with me.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Well, she's really close with you.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos doesn't do that to most people.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: *Sigh*... I'd rather she treated me a little more normal...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Let's go to bed. We have training first thing tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Be sure to wake Kroos up. She looked pretty tired when she got back. She just might not get up on her own.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Relax, Fang, I'll drag her there if I have to.

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Whatever, not gonna worry too much about it.
